mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.2%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%) indicates a weak labor market, which signals economic distress and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply recovery phase (INDPRO above 95.0), manufacturing sector expansion boosts corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.25 percentage points in the last 3 months) signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increasing) indicates economic health, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is increasing over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change above 2.5%) signals an environment where the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
